note: Written for a mixed-age Australian lounge room: a nine year old and a grandparent should both be able to answer honestly, in front of each other. Nothing about drinking, romance, money or anything a guest would rather not say out loud.
words: Has a middle name they do not like
Has sung in front of people
Has been up before 5am this week
Has the same birthday month as the person on their left
Has moved house more than five times
Has been camping in the last year
Has read a whole book this month
Has a scar with a good story
Can do an impression of someone here
Has fallen asleep in a cinema
